Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023/439 of Cr.P.C.
for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.108/2024, dated 15.11.2024, registered at Police Station - Mahila Thana, District Singrauli (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 74, 331(3), 351(2) of BNS.

entities.text: Police Station - Mahila Thana, District Singrauli
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Applicant is in detention since 16.11.2024.
2

As per the prosecution story, on 15.11.2024 applicant's daughter in law aged 31 years lodged an FIR stating that on 02.11.2024 when she was alone at home, her father-in-law raped her and pressurized her to enter into compromise in earlier case lodged by her.
FIR was registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated in a false and fabricated case on account of property dispute in the family.
FIR has been lodged after an inordinate delay of 13 days.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.

1 4.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant on the ground that he has criminal background of two cases and out of these cases one is under Section 376 of IPC and that FIR was lodged by the prosecutrix of this case.

5 Having taken into consideration the inordinate delay caused in registration of FIR and other facts and circumstances of the case including the material available on record, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I deem it a fit case for grant of bail.

Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Narayan Dev Vishwakarma be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS/437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
